seo.metaTitle: PDF flattener & form locker — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Flatten interactive AcroForm fields, checkboxes, and signature appearances into static page content for IRS 1099, USCIS, and notary submissions. Runs 100% locally in your browser with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: PDF flattener & form locker processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.question: Does PDF flattener & form locker upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No. PDF flattener & form locker executes 100% inside your browser's local memory. No data leaves your device.

faqs.question: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate PDF flattener & form locker?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/pdf_flatten.json or open /tools/pdf-flatten?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
